jobs.name: 1250_刚出炉的南瓜磅蛋糕.png
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create one portrait 4:5 image, a casual phone snapshot as seen INSIDE a gentle 2D anime world. This is a private everyday image sent to a friend, without phone UI, message captions, borders or collage.
References: image 1 is the PRIMARY style reference only: thin warm-brown drawing lines, airy light flat colors, very restrained soft cel shadows. Image 2 is a SECONDARY reference for intimate cropped first-person everyday composition and gentle palette only. Do not copy clothing, lace, sewing tools, reference labels or layout.
Crucial: keep the original reference anime drawing style. Objects use clear simplified silhouettes and broad flat color shapes with at most one or two shadow planes. Complex materials must NOT become more realistic: no porous crumbs, dense speckles, individual fibers, elaborate reflections, photographic food texture, realistic CGI, painted microdetail, bokeh or artificial grain. Casual feeling comes from close motivated cropping, not blur or dramatic camera tilt.
No people, faces, face reflections, character portraits, or screens. Do not make an establishing shot of a room, commercial product photograph, elegant arranged still life or anime background panorama.
Scene: a small cafe kitchen at about 12:50, October daytime. Mittes has finished baking pumpkin pound cake and brushed a thin syrup coating; she has stepped back from the hot work to briefly photograph the thing whose aroma caught her attention.
Subject and framing: close first-person downward oblique view of ONE whole unsliced rectangular pumpkin pound cake resting on a simple wire cooling rack. Cake occupies most of the frame, slightly off-center; rack and counter cropped by image edges. A small plain pastry brush rests at the far edge of the worktop, partly cropped. This is only a fragment of the workspace. No other food or decorations.
Cake design: warm muted pumpkin-gold block, simple domed top, a single broadly drawn baking split, 2 or 3 broad toasted color patches. Thin syrup indicated by one small soft highlight, not a glossy photographic crust. No seeds, nuts, frosting, steam cloud or crumb detailing. Rack is light simple lines; pale worktop is almost flat, no wood grain. Warm natural light, restrained soft shadows.
No text in image.

jobs.name: 2120_南瓜蛋糕卖完了.png
jobs.prompt:

Scene: same small cafe at closing around 21:20. Mittes is counting the remaining desserts and notices all pumpkin pound cake has sold out, with exactly TWO caramel nut tarts remaining.
Subject and framing: close first-person downward view through an OPEN display-cabinet door, focused on an empty cream-colored rectangular pastry tray lined with plain pale paper. Tray fills most of the image, slightly cropped; just a few simply drawn crumbs remain. At its front edge a small plain shop card clearly reads exactly "南瓜磅蛋糕". Beside it, partially entering the right side of frame, is a second tray holding exactly TWO small round caramel nut tarts. Both tarts visible enough to count. Frame only this small portion of shelf; no whole cafe, no wide cabinet panorama.
Rendering: tarts are simplified anime food, scalloped shell silhouette and only a handful of flat oval nut shapes, each WITHOUT internal texture. Muted caramel fill, one small highlight, no intricate piled nuts. Empty tray has almost flat cream color and one pale shadow, a few line indications of its rim. Soft warm indoor light, quiet end-of-day mood, NO cinematic lighting. No glass reflections. No sales graphics, no 'sold out' overlay, no extra props, no hands required.
The empty space on the pumpkin tray is the actual thing she wants to show her friend.
